name: Hypertension Management
description: A guided care journey for managing high blood pressure
disclaimer: General education, not diagnosis. Your provider's instructions take priority.

milestones.title: Getting Started
items: Set up daily blood pressure tracking (morning and evening)
Log all current medications with dosages
Record your baseline readings for 3 consecutive days
Note any symptoms: headaches, dizziness, fatigue
milestones.nudgeText: Start tracking your blood pressure to establish a baseline.

milestones.title: Building the Routine
items: Check BP at the same times each day for consistency
Track sodium intake — aim for under 2,300mg/day
Begin or maintain 30 min of light activity most days
Note how medications make you feel (side effects)
milestones.nudgeText: Consistent tracking helps your provider adjust your care plan.

milestones.title: First Check-In Window
items: Review your 4-week trend — is BP trending down?
Prepare questions for your provider using Visit Prep
Share your logged data at your follow-up appointment
Discuss any side effects or concerns
milestones.nudgeText: Consider scheduling a follow-up to review your first month of data.

milestones.title: Adjusting & Optimizing
items: Your provider may adjust medication based on your data
Continue daily tracking to measure the effect of changes
Monitor for new symptoms after any medication adjustment
Start noting correlations: sleep quality, stress, and BP

milestones.title: Establishing Your Baseline
items: Your readings should be stabilizing in a consistent range
Identify your personal patterns (time of day, stress triggers)
Reduce measurement frequency if provider agrees (e.g., once daily)
Continue medication adherence tracking
milestones.nudgeText: A 3-month follow-up helps confirm your treatment plan is working.

milestones.title: Ongoing Management
items: Monthly BP check-ins to catch any drift
Track lifestyle factors that affect your readings
Annual comprehensive review with your provider
Share your long-term trends using the Care Report
